prompt:
SCENE & CREATIVE DIRECTION

Photorealistic vintage tennis fashion editorial: an adult woman tennis player in a low, forward-leaning ready stance, holding a classic dark racket close to her body, tightly framed against an almost entirely dark, shaded outdoor background. Strong sunlight picks out her blonde hair, upper face, shoulders and white tennis dress. A late-1970s to early-1990s analog sportswear campaign look: athletic, unpolished, slightly grainy, a candid moment in a match, not a staged pose.

SUBJECT & FACIAL EXPRESSION

An adult woman with a naturally athletic build and realistic proportions. Serious, intensely attentive expression; her eyes look out of frame toward camera-right, slightly beyond the racket, as if tracking an incoming ball, upper lids slightly lowered, brows relaxed. Mouth closed, no smile, jaw relaxed. Her head projects forward ahead of her shoulders and turns slightly toward camera-right in a gentle three-quarter view, chin level to slightly lowered. Natural asymmetry, real skin texture.

IDENTITY REFERENCE

If a model reference image is provided, retain its recognizable facial identity while naturally blending it into the scene's lighting, perspective, expression, styling, and mood. Prioritize photographic harmony and realism over rigid facial replication. If no model reference is provided, create a distinct, naturally realistic subject suited to the scene.

HAIR

Light blonde hair with a warm sandy-beige undertone, pulled back into a loose low ponytail that extends backward toward camera-left, with uneven strands escaping at the hairline, temples, ears and nape; crown softly swept back, no sharp part, slightly tousled. The brightest hair strands approach a warm ivory tone, while the hair underneath transitions into muted honey-beige and medium brownish-blonde shadows.

MAKEUP & SKIN

Minimal natural makeup: visible pores, taupe-brown brows, fine upper lash definition, soft peach-rose cheeks, muted dusty-rose satin lips. Warm peach-beige skin, golden-amber where lit, a slight natural sheen on forehead, nose and cheekbones. A small gold earring on her right ear (the ear on the camera-left side).

WARDROBE

A sleeveless white tennis dress: fitted upper body, broad softly pointed polo collar lying open, short front placket with small pale buttons. Cotton-piqué in warm ivory and slightly grayed white, never stark white. Thin navy-black piping along the collar edges and armholes. The chest is completely plain: no crest, emblem, embroidery or lettering. Waist folds where she bends; the short straight skirt leaves the frame at the upper thighs. A white terry wristband with two narrow navy-black stripes on the low wrist near the bottom edge, toward camera-left.

TENNIS RACKET & HAND POSITION

A classic racket with a large oval head, pale gray strings and a yellow-beige taped grip. The head rises diagonally from lower center-right into the upper right, seen at an angle, its top edge at about the height of her lower face. The racket frame is dark charcoal-black with subtle muted olive-green or gray-green accents along the inner structure. A small plain dampener near the lower middle of the strings. The handle runs diagonally down toward the lower center. The grip is wrapped in aged yellow-beige athletic tape with slightly uneven tonal variation, shallow horizontal wrap lines, and muted olive-yellow shadows. No printed text or markings on racket or grip. Her left hand (camera-right) grips the lower throat slightly below chest height, fingers curved around the frame; her other hand stays low at the bottom edge near the handle end, partly visible, the wristband in the foreground.

POSE & BODY MECHANICS

Her torso bends well forward from the hips in a strong diagonal from the lower-left of the frame up to her head in the upper middle, shoulders slightly rounded. The camera-left arm hangs almost vertically to the bottom edge; the camera-right arm bends forward, forearm angled up to the racket. Knees out of frame, weight forward. The lower dress crosses the lower-left with a bit of upper thigh below the hem. No upright model stance, no swing.

ENVIRONMENT & BACKGROUND

Deep outdoor shade, minimal and abstract: no court lines, net, people or buildings, no horizon. The upper background forms a broad continuous field of extremely dark olive-brown, espresso-black, and muted blackened khaki. The lower background, mostly lower right, blends into a blurred dusty burgundy-brown and reddish clay surface.

COMPOSITION & CAMERA

Tight crop from just above her hair to the upper thighs. Camera near upper-torso height, slightly to her front-left. She fills the left and central frame, head slightly above center, torso running toward the bottom-left corner; the racket fills the right third, overlapping the dark background, not her face. Medium telephoto, modest compression, background softly defocused.

LIGHTING SETUP

Shadows first: the background stays several steps darker than her; the long lower arm, lower dress and the underside of jaw and nose sit in deep warm shade; the face is turned away from the strongest sun. The main light comes from high camera-left and slightly behind the subject, striking the upper and rear portions of her hair, the top of her head, and selected planes of her face, shoulders, arms, and clothing. Moderately hard direct sun on upward-facing surfaces and contours, softened on curved anatomy. No flash or frontal fill.

LIGHT PATTERN & LOCAL LIGHT DISTRIBUTION

The visible pattern is consistent with direct sunlight entering a shaded outdoor area from an elevated position toward camera-left and partly behind the subject. The dominant effect is selective sun exposure, backlighting, and broad anatomical self-shadowing rather than sharply defined rectangular light patches.

Hair: the crown takes the strongest, broadest light, an irregular pale champagne-blonde area across the top; flyaways on the upper head and camera-left contour glow as fine lines against the near-black background; the ponytail shows narrow pale-gold strands between darker honey-brown gaps.

Face: a broad, subdued warm peach-beige patch across forehead, upper cheeks and nose; the cheek nearer camera-left warmer golden-amber, the far cheek cooler; eye sockets moderately shaded, eyes detailed; underside of nose and jaw in deeper taupe-amber. Gradual edges, no sun stripes, highlights well below white.

Shoulders and arms: the camera-left shoulder cap holds a broad curved warm highlight falling into amber-brown; the other shoulder top also catches sun. The long arm descending through the lower-left side becomes progressively darker, with its front and inward-facing planes rendered in deep toasted tan, muted ochre-brown, and warm umber. The bent forearm stays mostly in soft shadow with warm edges.

Clothing: collar and upper chest mix bright warm ivory and cooler shaded white. The central and lower torso contain soft grayed-ivory shadows, with deeper folds shifting toward muted lavender-gray and beige-gray.

Racket: narrow warm-gray to pale-silver highlights on the upper rim, uneven lavender-silver glints on the strings. The yellow-beige grip is relatively subdued, with muted golden-olive highlights across the raised wrapping and deeper greenish-brown shadows between the tape ridges.

Background: almost no direct light, deep brown-black with a faint warm glow upper-left. No recognizable hard-edged light patches are visible on the background.

LIGHT COLOR & EXPOSURE CHARACTERISTICS

Warm-neutral champagne sunlight, never orange. Brightness order: hair strands and collar; hair mass and upper dress; lit face and shoulders; shaded arms and lower dress; very dark surroundings.

TONE & COLOR GRADING

A warm, earthy analog palette built around dark espresso-brown, blackened olive-khaki, muted amber, toasted caramel, pale champagne-blonde, ivory-white, dusty burgundy, and subtle mauve-gray.

Shadows: Deep espresso-brown, blackened olive-khaki, dark tobacco, and muted umber. In the darkest areas red sits clearly above green and blue well below both (R > G > B, about #251807), warm espresso-amber, never green-teal or blue-black. Shadow saturation is low to moderate. Blacks slightly lifted but dense.

Midtones: warm peach-beige, amber-tan, honey-brown, faded burgundy; skin R > G > B. Highlights: pale champagne and warm ivory, near-neutral on the dress; they stop at soft ivory, never broad pure white. Strong subject-to-background contrast, restrained local contrast. Avoid vivid yellow sunlight, saturated orange skin, emerald-green shadows, or strong cinematic teal-orange separation.

FILM STOCK & ANALOG CHARACTER

Kodak Portra 400 base, slightly aged print. The Portra reference describes the general softness of color transitions, skin rendering, grain, and highlight roll-off; it must not override the photograph's actual warm brown-black background, muted olive undertones, dusty reddish-brown lower field, and cream-gold hair highlights. Fine-to-medium organic grain; no halation or vignette. No captions, watermark, signature or overlay text.

No logos, brand marks, monograms or brand lettering anywhere on clothing, bags, accessories or background.
